text: ManageState calculates monthly income, expenses, and net income from property transactions.

source.basis: The shipping app loads the current year's property transactions and calculates monthly income, expenses, and netIncome values.

text: ManageState can upload documents for a property and save their document metadata.

source.basis: The shipping app uploads a property document to storage and saves its URL, path, type, size, uploader, and document type in the property_documents record.

text: ManageState can export property, transaction, recurring-item, and monthly-summary data as an XLSX workbook.

source.basis: The shipping app builds property, transaction, recurring-item, and monthly-summary sheets, writes an XLSX workbook, and shares the generated file when sharing is available.
